title: Trip Protection Claim Denial Reasons and Recovery of Overlapping Roamhaven Refunds
content:
Trip Protection claims are decided by the underwriter's claims team at Harbor Mutual Travel Insurance Company. Roamhaven support never decides a claim; the underwriter's claims team does. This guidance sets out the reasons a claim is denied and how a benefit is recovered when Roamhaven later refunds the same amounts.

## Filing period

A claim must be submitted within the plan's claim filing period of calendar days after the loss. A claim submitted later is denied as filed late.

## Denial reasons

| The claim | Denial reason recorded |
|---|---|
| Was submitted after the filing period | filed late |
| Rests on a reason outside the plan's covered reasons | reason not covered |
| Rests on an excluded pre-existing condition | pre-existing condition |
| Does not carry the plan's required claim documentation | insufficient documentation |
| Is a CFAR claim made inside the CFAR cutoff | CFAR too late |
| Concerns amounts Roamhaven had already refunded in full | no loss |

A denial is recorded against the claim with its reason.

## Recovery of overlapping Roamhaven refunds

When Roamhaven refunds amounts on the stay after the plan paid a benefit on those same amounts, the overlap is recovered from the guest, as the plan's terms on Roamhaven refunds provide. A recovery is never more than the net benefits on the policy: every benefit paid under the policy over its lifetime less every amount already recovered on it. Benefits paid are booked to the policy's benefits as money in, and recoveries as money out, each recovery tied to the benefit payment it reduces.

## Recovery worked through (hypothetical amounts)

| Situation | Overlap from the later Roamhaven refund | Net benefits on the policy before the recovery | Amount recovered |
|---|---|---|---|
| Benefit of 1400.00 USD paid; Roamhaven later refunds 300.00 USD of the same amounts | 300.00 USD | 1400.00 USD | 300.00 USD |
| Same policy, 1300.00 USD already recovered; Roamhaven later refunds a further 250.00 USD of the same amounts | 250.00 USD | 100.00 USD | 100.00 USD |

In the second row the overlap of 250.00 USD is more than the 100.00 USD of net benefits left on the policy, so the recovery is held at 100.00 USD.
